Not all courses are given in English every year, students must take the course in the given year.
Class Attendance Procedure Students must be present at every study session (class, exercise, seminar, etc.), which is set for them as part of the curriculum plan. Attendance will be checked in every class, exercise, or seminar and reported to the school secretary.
Students, who for justified reasons cannot participate in class, must notify the course teacher and the studies committee in writing of this along with the reasoning (illness, etc.).
Students who are absent from school for 14 days in a row without a sufficient and reasoned reason and/or without the approval of the school management, their studies will be terminated.
Students who intend to be absent from school for professional reasons (concert, competition, auditions) must receive the approval of the personal teacher for this activity and submit a written request (along with the teacher's approval and official invitation documents) to the school's studies committee. The request must be submitted to the committee at least three weeks before the start of the planned period of absence.
All references to the teaching committee will be through a studies committee link https://tau-ac.my.salesforce.com/.
Students who fail a course, will have to take it again in the following year and cover its full cost by themselves.
Attendance in Orchestra, Choir Rehearsals & Chamber Music
Participation determined by auditions and needs of the orchestra. Students must participate in every activity on behalf of the school in which they will be required to participate and in each of the rehearsals scheduled for the activity including rehearsals and performances during the vacation period.
Students must reserve the days and hours of the orchestra's rehearsals, Sundays, Wednesdays 4:00-7:00 p.m. Due to the special nature of the studies in the practical majors - rehearsals, performances and personal lessons may also take place during the vacation periods, these activities will be an inseparable part of the curriculum and the study duties. Students will be obligated to rehearsals and special events (the rehearsal dates of the orchestra and the choir can be changed according to the needs of the school). If needed, the students in performance classes can be divided into groups, deadlines can be changed and additional rehearsals can be scheduled.
Students, who missed more than two orchestra, choir rehearsals, attendance at the contemporary music workshop course, or the wind instruments (wood and brass) workshops for other than justifiable reasons (such as illness for which there is a medical certificate), will not have their participation recognized in and they will have to repeat the course the following year.
This procedure also refers to special educational meetings - seminars, workshops, etc. - that take place in addition to the regular hours. The dates of these activities will be announced in advance by the international program and the orchestra managers.
*Required attendance at the weekly department composition meetings (not included in the total hours needed to complete the degree).
Final requirementsPractical examination - Submission of 5 original pieces for the final examination:
A work for solo instrument or for an instrument with piano accompaniment;
A choral work: a cappella or with an ensemble accompaniment (use of electronic means is permitted);
A work for an ensemble (at least 12 instruments) with or without instrumental or vocal solo;
A orchestral work;
A chamber work for 3-6 instruments.
Oral examination for all courses of studies (excluding composition students):
An oral examination will take place on the repertoire of final recitals/final examinations that will show proficiency and knowledge of the music material of the following aspects: Harmony, Counterpoint, Structure including background stylistic and historical aspects of the piece, the composer and the genre.
OR
A philosophical or analytic paper consisting of 30 pages under the instruction and supervision of a faculty member*.
*Writing a paper is conditional to the approval of the studies committee
Weight of the Final Grades - Composition:
65% - grade of the main study
20% - course grades
15% - seminar papers
Graduation
Students who have completed all of the requirements for the degree and received all of the grades, must fill out the "Excursions Form - Graduates" in the "Personal Information" page.
It is the responsibility of the student to fulfill the curriculum requirements throughout the degree.
